notes.title: Update - Avatars, SVG, many fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29980654/7a41fc57c25aae1491a193544a4008370e77da4c.png[/img]

Hello!

We have just updated CollabHub and are nearly ready to transition to full release.  This update contains many improvements:

[list]
[*]Customizable avatars
[*]Faster loading times for both scenes
[*]Improved performance in the winter scene
[*]Exporting to SVG
[*]Private rooms
[*]Many bug fixes
[/list]

We will continue to polish and fix any remaining issues and should transition to full release very soon.  We hope you give it a try and as always let us know if you have any feedback.

-Martin

notes.title: Collab mode beta + new shapes!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29980654/419a7ed2549bdd5a3ae860eea6b4ade714069fc8.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

I'm here with another major release and some features that were long under development.  I'm pleased to bring you the collab mode beta!  Also, new shapes for flow diagrams, along with selection and text tools!

The collab mode beta lets you join others in a room to draw and diagram together.  You can move the drawing board around the environment, draw with shapes or freehand, write text, and have it all synchronized.  For this release, you have a choice of 12 avatars which include networked voice and lip synch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29980654/f9a4c02ceb2dfeded02a7be7ffc91f11ae4808d0.gif[/img]

The shapes menu now includes 18 additional shapes, with a whole new page dedicated to shapes for flow diagrams.  The newly added selection tool will now let you select shapes that have been drawn and move and resize those shapes, either as a group or single shapes.  The new text tool will bring up a virtual keyboard and let you type using laser pointers.  Text will be added to the drawing board and the font size can be increased / decreased or font color changed with a set of buttons at the top of the keyboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29980654/50bb14be45d1cd2fe9c4be28caccbf0774a22198.gif[/img]

There are number of performance improvements as well, most notably the load time for the winter scene. 
 Please keep in mind the collab mode is beta for now, although it has been well tested.  Hope you’ll try it out!  As usual, your feedback is most welcome.

-Martin

notes.title: Big Update - Major Revamp + Rift Support!
notes.notes:
Hello!  We are back with a massive update after more than a year of work.  The update includes a major revamp of the visuals, new environments, board materials and tool panel.  With this release, we are also very excited to support Oculus Rift!  There's so much in this release, lets go through each item separately:

[h1]New Environments[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29980654/e2b77489575382004fc6243db1188475c3d979cf.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29980654/7110e77e28e4e7b9f5b7a6b06d5ac92dff8409a5.png[/img]

There are 2 beautiful new environments to work in: Summer and Winter.  Easily toggle between each environment and load any drawings or diagrams you've done and continue working.

[h1]Move Board[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29980654/02739e9af4fa17057974e97466885b19434b2ca3.gif[/img]

The tool panel now has a 'Move Board' button that when pressed lets you move the board around the environment and place it on a wall of your choice.  If you feel like working outside, take your board and work and move it all with you.

[h1]Board Materials[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29980654/83e59f6ca6d860a122f6bf8b7f51f622a5aa75ce.gif[/img]

A new 'Smooth Plastic' material becomes the default material.  It has a nice smooth feel, while partially reflecting the environment behind you.  If you prefer not to have any reflection, there is the 'Unlit' board material.  You can also vary the opacity of the board to have a see-through glass feel.  With the 'Unlit' board material, you can also change the color.

[h1]Tool Panel[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29980654/43ceb8dc4bac0ce26cc6a0b498bb3548ee3cc3a0.gif[/img]

The tool panel has been completely re-modelled and has 3D buttons that pop out as you hover over them.  A laser pointer and cursor help you navigate through different options.

We would love to know what you think.  Please let us know of any bugs or suggestions for further releases!

- Martin

notes.title: CollabHub 1.1 - Import Images, Recent Colors + more
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29980654/5f919dd91320bd853e6d5cccb5c386ab6a1c1083.png[/img]

We are excited to put out this major release of CollabHub that adds several key features:
[list]
[*] [b]Import Images:[/b] browse for images files on your computer using the file browser and add them to your whiteboard.  Move and resize the image for the perfect placement alongside your shapes and diagrams.
[*] [b]Recent Colors:[/b] 5 of the most recently used colors appear below the color palette to easily switch between those you use the most.
[*] You can now hold the left grip button to move the whiteboard with your controller to avoid having to teleport to find the right drawing space.
[*] Repositioning the whiteboard through settings no longer forces you to create a new canvas.  Your existing drawings and shapes move with the whiteboard.
[*] Settings panel now has tabs that separate 'General' and 'Board' settings.
[/list]
As always, any comments or questions from the community are very welcome.

notes.title: CollabHub Launches!
notes.notes:
We are super excited to announce the early access launch of CollabHub!  Thank you to all who participated in the public beta and for your feedback.  We are looking forward to continued feedback from the community and will do our best to fix any issues or bugs.

If you have any suggestions or feature requests we would love to hear them!  We will be doing releases periodically over the coming weeks and months leading up to a full release.

Stay tuned!
